## Key Sources

1.  **PDP VIII (Power Development Plan VIII):** The official national power plan approved in May 2023. It is the primary source for project status (Approved, Cancelled) and future COD estimates. [Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) - PDP VIII](https://moit.gov.vn/en/Pages/Quy-hoach-dien-VIII.aspx)
2.  **Global Energy Monitor (GEM):** Provides detailed, project-level data on coal and gas plants globally, including Vietnam, with extensive referencing. Crucial for historical COD, technology, and status verification. [GEM Coal Plant Tracker](https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-coal-plant-tracker/) & [GEM Gas Plant Tracker](https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-gas-plant-tracker/)
3.  **International Energy Agency (IEA) - Vietnam Energy Outlook 2022:** Provides context, validation of operational fleet data, and analysis of policy shifts. [IEA Vietnam 2022](https://www.iea.org/reports/viet-nam-energy-outlook-2022)
4.  **Vietnam Electricity (EVN):** State utility providing summaries of operational plants and PDP VIII. [EVN PDP VIII Summary](https://www.evn.com.vn/c3/hoat-dong-san-xuat-kinh-doanh/so-luoc-quy-hoach-phat-trien-dien-luc-quoc-gia-thoi-ky-2021-2030-tam-nhin-den-nam-2050-pdp-viii-23355.aspx)
5.  **PV Gas (PetroVietnam Gas):** State gas company operating major domestic gas-fired plants. [PV Gas Power Generation Portfolio](https://www.pvgas.com.vn/en/business/power-generation)

## Important Caveats
